title: Integration diagnostics
testKey: Open this panel and confirm the active project and task totals match shared state. The runtime checks should each show PASS or FAIL based on the current data, and should update if shared state changes.
html:

css: .diagnostics{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#0f1722;color:#edf3fa;border:1px solid #293a50;border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.diagnostics header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.kicker{margin:0 0 3px;color:#91a5bf;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em}.diagnostics h2{margin:0;font-size:23px}.overall{padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#203148;color:#c6d5e6;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase}.overall.good{background:#173d31;color:#a5e4c5}.overall.bad{background:#46252a;color:#ffc0c3}.headline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) minmax(300px,1.5fr);gap:10px;margin:16px 0}.active-project,.counts{background:#151f2d;border:1px solid #283a50;border-radius:12px;padding:12px}.active-project span,.counts span{color:#94a8c0;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}.active-project strong{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:19px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.counts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}.counts div{min-width:0}.counts strong{display:block;font-size:19px}.checks{display:grid;gap:7px}.check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #2a3c52;border-radius:10px;background:#151f2d}.check-index{color:#7f95af;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}.check-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.check-result{padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em}.check-result.pass{background:#173d31;color:#a5e4c5}.check-result.fail{background:#46252a;color:#ffc0c3}@media(max-width:680px){.headline{grid-template-columns:1fr}.counts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
js: const $=s=>root.querySelector(s);const nameOf=p=>p?(p.name||p.title||String(p.id)):'No active project';const noteFor=(notes,p)=>{if(!p||notes==null)return null;if(typeof notes==='string')return notes;if(Array.isArray(notes))return notes.find(n=>String(n.projectId||n.id)===String(p.id))||null;if(typeof notes==='object')return notes[p.id]??notes[String(p.id)]??notes[nameOf(p)]??null;return null;};const render=()=>{const state=api.cloneState();const projects=Array.isArray(state.projects)?state.projects:[];const tasks=Array.isArray(state.tasks)?state.tasks:[];const active=projects.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(state.activeProjectId))||null;const status=v=>String(v||'Todo').toLowerCase();const todo=tasks.filter(t=>status(t.status)==='todo').length;const doing=tasks.filter(t=>status(t.status)==='doing').length;const done=tasks.filter(t=>status(t.status)==='done').length;$('[data-active-project]').textContent=nameOf(active);$('[data-total]').textContent=tasks.length;$('[data-todo]').textContent=todo;$('[data-doing]').textContent=doing;$('[data-done]').textContent=done;const ids=tasks.map((t,i)=>String(t.id??t.taskId??'missing-'+i));const section=state.workspaceSection||'Overview';const checks=[['Projects state is an array',Array.isArray(state.projects)],['Exactly three shared projects are present',projects.length===3],['activeProjectId resolves to a shared project',!!active],['Tasks state is an array',Array.isArray(state.tasks)],['At least eight shared tasks are present',tasks.length>=8],['Every shared task has a nonblank title',tasks.every(t=>String(t.title||'').trim().length>0)],['Task identifiers are unique',new Set(ids).size===ids.length],['Task statuses are Todo, Doing, or Done',tasks.every(t=>['todo','doing','done'].includes(status(t.status)))],['Workspace section is valid',['Overview','Tasks','Notes'].includes(section)],['Notes state exists for runtime use',state.notes!=null],['Active-project note can be resolved',noteFor(state.notes,active)!=null],['Status counts add up to total tasks',todo+doing+done===tasks.length]];const host=$('[data-checks]');host.innerHTML='';checks.forEach((c,i)=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='check';const idx=document.createElement('span');idx.className='check-index';idx.textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='check-name';label.textContent=c[0];const result=document.createElement('span');result.className='check-result '+(c[1]?'pass':'fail');result.textContent=c[1]?'PASS':'FAIL';row.append(idx,label,result);host.appendChild(row);});const passed=checks.filter(c=>c[1]).length;const overall=$('[data-overall]');overall.textContent=passed+'/'+checks.length+' checks passing';overall.className='overall '+(passed===checks.length?'good':'bad');};render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
